heading: `oa_list` — the multimap value adapter
text:
### `oa_list` — the multimap value adapter [IRET.28.8]

`oa_list` is the `oa` value for the multimap tables (`ridx`, `lmem_idx`,
`ralpha_idx`, `ltok_idx`: key → set of element pointers). It mirrors
today's inline-array + heap-overflow scheme so small per-key
fan-out stays allocation-free. The inline count `OA_LIST_INLINE` **must**
match `DS_RIDX_INLINE` (= 8, `beta.h`): a smaller value would spill
to `heap` sooner and, in RT-locked mode where heap growth is forbidden
(`[IRET.28.11.2]`), would regress allocation-free fan-out capacity below
the pre-`oa` tables.
